newsitem.title: USA: Rubin plans to stay at Treasury for long time.
newsitem.headline: Rubin plans to stay at Treasury for long time.

text.p: U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said on Sunday he intends to stay in his post "for quite some time."
"I will be here for a good long time to come," Rubin told NBC television's Meet the Press program. "I have no reason to think I won't be here until the year 2000."
He was responding to recent rumors in Washington and on Wall Street that he might step down as Treasury chief before the end of President Clinton's second term, possibly by the end of this year.
